outcome: Ophthalmic artery peak systolic velocity ratio (OA PSV-ratio)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies presenting between 32+0 and 36+6 weeks of gestation with pre-eclampsia, gestational hypertension, or chronic hypertension.
finding: Pre-eclampsia is an independent predictor of a higher Ophthalmic artery peak systolic velocity ratio (OA PSV-ratio), even after controlling for maternal weight, age, antihypertensive medications, and mean arterial pressure (MAP).
